clips.title: The story
paras: Southwest of Sen'jin Village, Lar Prowltusk watches the Durotar frontier. He guards the young troll settlement and sends travelers against nearby threats.

Lar Prowltusk watches the coast southwest of Sen'jin Village. As a Darkspear sentinel, he helps guard the tribe's new home after its people fled their sunken island chain. Hostile neighbors keep harassing Sen'jin Village as the trolls work to secure a permanent home. Lar directs scouts and warriors to watch the coast and curb these attacks, especially those by the Kolkar centaur, giving the settlement room to breathe.
